title: Chapter 998
paragraphs: Chapter 998
Episode 246. Mithra Desert Conquest Battle (8)
Kiiiing, cragagagak-!
The airborne fortress and fleet began to spew scarlet enemy energy shells.
[Good, good! We'll become stronger today!]
[Marlun, let's absorb it quickly!]
[Ooh, Shuri.]

Sreevi and Karmash surrendered their bodies to the falling enemy energy shells with greedy eyes. Marlun couldn't take his eyes off Shuri until then, and Shuri escaped his burdensome gaze by returning to her fox form.
“Hm!”
Beliz let out a heavy shout and swung his great sword.
Jin's mind was filled with memories of the day he fought with Beliz in the past Duel of Kings, giving him goosebumps.
‘That day, despite fighting with ease, the Beliz brothers managed to defeat me in the end... Though I did cut off Beliz's right arm.’
Beliz smiled at Jin as if reading his thoughts, once he completed the sword swing.
“Our Jin, you won the title of 'Sword of Jay' in the Duel of Kings, but you were a little weaker than me. Now you've truly risen. I'm proud of you, brother.”
While Beliz was speaking, a giant blue sword energy that seemed to cover the entire airborne fortress tore through the enemy energy shells and shot into the sky.
It was like sand being swept away by a wave. The firepower of the airborne fortresses wasn't extremely high, but the enemy tribe had no choice but to emit their ships.
‘Is this not a level that even the Qing Dynasty's Duel Kings couldn't compare to...?’
‘How many of these guys are there? These two can't be all of them!’
Linpa's following sword energy was the same.

Her sword energy had a strange acceleration that could be instantly recognized even within the fleet. At first, it slowly extended, but when it collided with the enemy energy shells, it accelerated explosively, making it difficult to trace its path.
“Genesis... amazing. It's an honor to be your sister.”
Two strands of blue sword energy were pounding the red sky.
And in the middle of them, a giant golden flash rose. Golden Lightning of the King of Swords, Genesis's newly realized golden thunder tore the fleet's protective shield.

The energy of the airborne fortress and fleet seemed relatively weak. The fleet naturally overpowered in terms of sheer strength, but the condensed power of the two Duel Kings near Genesis was ignoring weight class.
“Wow, what's that golden lightning? It's cool!?”
“Teach me too...”
There was not a trace of tension to be found in Jin and his brothers. The enemy brain cannons were now pushed so close to the sky that one could not even describe them as "falling."
[Oh yeah! I came expecting some local, decent restaurant food, and suddenly, top-class dishes are being poured out! Isn't it, Karumasu, Masalrun!]

[Yes, Sribi! If the taste of the enemy brain cannons is that of scrap meat soaked in spices, then this energy is like the essence made from the vile human souls. Masalrun! What are you doing not eating it quickly!]

[Masalrun is lost in sorrow. Shuri has rejected Masalrun and disappeared... But this may also be a way to praise sorrow. Masalrun will deeply sympathize with the loneliness and sadness that Shuri must have felt in the Black Sea...]
[That, that crazy guy, really.]
Sribi and Karumasu roamed the void, filled with energy, like fish meeting water. Masalrun had been muttering Shuri's name while hunched over, yet the energy was still naturally being absorbed by him.
Shimat silently watched their performance from the bridge of the ship for a while.
"Sigh."
A deep sigh welled up from within.
The Vamel Alliance had inexplicably added two Nameless of the highest level, and the demons were cackling and making a fuss; it was enough to make him feel suffocated.
‘The feeling is not good... It's as if a part of the Sun God's will is blessing the Vamel Alliance, to the point where it seems that way.’
It didn't seem like just a feeling.
‘The likelihood that Ranke Halobiche would perform a demon summoning ceremony in the desert, and from there, several coincidences would overlap and hidden Nameless would join the Vamel Alliance...’
Even according to the technicians' reports, the biggest core of that coincidence was likely the firepower of the air fortress that hit the desert.
Could that really just be a coincidence?
Shimat thought not.

He was, perhaps, the mortal who knew more about the Sun God than anyone in ancient times. He knew that the Sun God's will was not singular, and he also knew that even after the god was known to be dead, those wills still lingered here and there in the world.
It was what was making Shimat uncomfortable. They were the ones trying to revive the Sun God and restore the world's order, but he couldn't understand why the god favored them.
‘Are you trying to make me an unfaithful believer? Sun God Kinzelo.’
Ugh...!
Shimat quelled his anger and opened the video communication window. Dozens of windows appeared, showing the Great Commanders and the commanders of each ship.

"The demons are relatively friendly to the Vamel Alliance compared to us. So, the Vamel Alliance will not hesitate to exert power. The more the demons grow, the more it will benefit them. We will conduct this battle with a focus on defense, and first, carefully analyze the combat capabilities of the descendants of the Blue Plutonian clan."

"Keep the order to increase the number of reconnaissance teams the same. Track the White Knight who has deserted the battlefield, and then the positions of Eliot and the subspace tracking technicians will appear. Make sure they can't return with new information."
{Yes!}
"Also, I will focus on subspace tracking while defending. Before all the descendants of Blue Plutonian escape, Laphralosa must be found and destroyed."
Laphralosa.
How dangerous this unknown subspace was had been sufficiently proven by just Beliz and Linpa.
77 people.
Of those, only ten remained as fighting kings, and half as fighting gods. Shimat was not sure of the exact scale but was confident.
The moment all the kings of Laphralosa safely escaped into the human world, it was clear that the enemy would lose their ground.

{The location of Laphralosa is definitely specified because of the recently summoned kings, fighting god. However, the enemy's resistance is fierce for destruction using a subspace tracker, and the fissures that can be struck without any particular action are continuously changing positions.}
Rimagas said. He was tirelessly analyzing Laphralosa's wavelength from the bridge of the Patlok.
"So what is Rimagas' opinion?"

{I think it would be good to deploy one more air fortress and conduct continuous shelling at the subspace location. That way, the randomly occurring fissures will have to be hit, and the aftershock will be transmitted entirely into subspace.}
Indeed, the 'fissures' currently forming at the entrance of Laphralosa were fully connected to the human world.
So the fighting energy that Vahn used to widen the passage when Beliz and Linpa left destroyed the enemy's reconnaissance team.
If the power used inside Laphralosa could strike the human world, the opposite was true as well.
"Okay. Let's deploy Kri."
Rimagas immediately shook his head.

{No, fighting god. Kri can certainly inflict the most significant damage on Laphralosa's fissure, but then our base will become too weak. Above all, the fighting energy that initially annihilated the reconnaissance fleet... that's too dangerous.}
Vahn's fighting energy.
Rimagas had been feeling a deep fear since analyzing the remnants of it with Patlok's equipment.
It seemed not so great in numerical terms, but the structure of that energy resembled something Rimagas knew well.

It was almost similar in form to the essence of the Sun God used in the air fortress Kri and the Sun Sword Tetalon. Rimagas had analyzed the energy of countless mortals and immortals, but he had never seen energy so similar to the Sun God's essence.
Clearly, that power would easily overpower their fighting god, Shimat. It was definite.
"If there are many listening ears, it seems there are things that cannot be spoken."
Shimat severed all communication links except for Limagas.
"Tell me in detail, Limagas."

{Inside there exists a power in a form similar to the essence of the sun god. It can only be assumed to be a much larger and more massive essence than what was used in Kri and Tetallon... such is the owner of this power.}
Shimat's pupils widened.
"......It must be a being referred to as the god of the descendants of the Clear Clan."
{Fellow god, the current battlefield is continually going beyond our predictions. It's entirely possible that this individual could suddenly break through the rift and escape.}
"So, is fellow Limagas concerned that Kri will be damaged in that case?"
At those words, Limagas momentarily looked for Shimat's reaction.

{...It's not a concern, fellow god. It's a certainty. Even if you, fellow god, were to engage in battle, leading Kri and all the aerial fortresses, my conclusion is that it would be impossible to kill him.}
You can never beat him, no matter what you do.
Limagas was the only one who could speak so bluntly to Shimat.

Indeed, neither in ancient times nor now had Shimat ever encountered a situation to hear such a direct statement. Even in his heyday, the Clear Wind Ruler or the Great Serpent could do nothing against Shimat, who led all the aerial fortresses.
Limagas was now saying that this rule might be broken.
"Even if we use the light of annihilation?"
{That's why I told you not to send out Kri to prevent that, even in the worst situation. If he appears unharmed in the world, rather use the witch.}
Limagas's judgment was always precise. He was the first to argue that they had to hide their divine status and evade the Great Serpent in ancient times.
Shimat immediately showed agreement with his opinion.
"A witch... even more dangerous than that peculiar being, you say. I understand. Then the best future now would be for the summoning of the Great Kings of Lafrarosa to stop by chance."
{Yes. There's no part where we can't directly intervene, so I'll do my best to stop it.}
"In some ways, much now rests in the hands of fellow Limagas rather than me. Be sure to bring good news."
{Understood.}
The communication window with Limagas was turned off.
Shimat moved the window reflecting the battlefield forward, looking at Jin, Beliz, Linpa, and the demons.
'I thought there would be no such obstacles after the Clear Wind Ruler and the Great Serpent of the Great Mountain... I never thought I would meet stronger enemies than those so soon.'
